$comment: The render context for templates/wlogout/style.css.tpl. Three absolute paths the consumer resolves; the template reads them in `{{ }}` interpolations only.
title: wlogout/style.css.tpl — render context
description: Every value the wlogout stylesheet reads: the palette import plus the runtime state-root pointers for icons and the current wallpaper. Skin paint/rhythm and typography come from the generated appearance sheet, which is imported last; that import is relative and needs no render variable.

COLORS_FILE_PATH.description: Absolute path to the rendered GTK palette fragment the stylesheet @imports (color-scheme-generator output consumed by the bar).

CURRENT_WALLPAPER_SYMLINK.description: Absolute path to the runtime-owned current wallpaper (window background). A stale or empty path renders a black window, not an error.

STATE_ROOT.description: The runtime state root; the six button icons are read from <STATE_ROOT>/dotfiles/current/icons/. Absolute by construction.

x-render-contract.no_default_on_required: No `default(` fallback on any of the three: an empty import path or icon root produces a stylesheet that loads and shows nothing — the failure this contract makes visible.
x-render-contract.destination: The consumer renders this to style.css beside the copied layout; this repository never ships the rendered file (AD-11).
